text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Good work.
Right now, I am explaining training methods
aimed at holding the "Grand Live" to anyone interested—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
<username>,
do you need an explanation?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Now then, what would you like me to explain?
Speaking of things to ask about training while preparing for the Grand Live—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: About the "Grand Live," yes.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The Grand Live was a concert that Umamusume
used to hold voluntarily in the past.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
With the spread of URA-led Winning Lives,
it hasn't been held in recent years,
so its current recognition is rather low.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
So! In order to rebuild the live concerts this time
and raise awareness among our new fans,
we're going to hold an announcement live♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
A total of four promotional lives will be held,
and each will be evaluated based on
the number of newly performed songs!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Holding highly rated Lives
leads to tremendous growth for the Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
To ensure the Grand Live is a success,
let's do our best so we can perform
as many songs as possible♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Furthermore, while participating in the Twinkle Series, everyone will also be preparing for the Grand Live.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Please note that depending on training conditions,
your training may conclude even during the
Grand Live announcement period!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"That concludes the explanation regarding the Grand Live.
Is there anything else you would like to ask?"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: You'd like to ask about "Performances," right?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
When training is successful,
you will acquire one of five types of performances.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Which performance you can gain from which training
varies every time, so please be sure to check carefully.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Also, the amount of Performance you gain will vary
depending on the Training Level and the number
of Umamusume training together.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: In particular, succeeding in Friendship Training seems to yield two types of Performance at once!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Also, it looks like you can earn Performances from various events too! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Efficiently earn performance points
and master even more songs and live techniques!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That concludes the explanation regarding "Performances."
Is there anything else you'd like to ask?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Regarding "Lessons", yes?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: In Lessons, you can use the Performance points gained from Training to learn songs and live techniques.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"When you master songs and live techniques,
you can earn bonuses
known as Mastery Bonuses♪"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Acquisition Bonuses offer a wealth of helpful effects for your training, such as stat boosts, energy recovery, and enhanced training workouts!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
For your trainee's growth,
please make good use of the lessons♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Additionally, by learning songs in lessons, you can earn extra bonuses known as Live Bonuses.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Newly acquired Live Bonuses will take effect continuously
once performed during the scheduled announcement lives.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: These offer many effects distinct from the Acquisition Bonuses, so be sure to make good use of them too♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: However, the number of songs you can learn before each Live is limited, so please be careful!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Also, when you're lacking the Performance needed to acquire a skill,
you can reserve a lesson instead.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: By booking Lessons, you can check which Performance points you're lacking during Training, so be sure to use it to help with your training regimen♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That concludes the explanation
for "Lessons".
Is there anything else you would like to know?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Are you truly all right?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Understood♪ Just to be sure, I have a brief summary right here.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You can review that explanation at any time
by tapping the 'i' button in the top left.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Well then, best of luck.
I'll be cheering you on quietly.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Understood. In that case, do your best,
okay? I'll be quietly cheering you on.
